summary: Iteration 4 (multi-user) tested end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass covering login role/status, admin CRUD, pending-user 403 gating, google-simulated user flow (mongosh), data isolation, project sharing via partner email + owner-only write, feasibility compute + CRUD, personal ledger separation from company pool, and regression (dashboard, shares PIN). Frontend: verified nav-admin appears immediately after email/pw login (no reload), Admin table lists Yash as admin/approved with NO delete button on own row, Feasibility live compute shows Total $1,600,000 / Profit $400,000 / Margin 20.0% / verdict 'Feasible', Personal Debts flow: 'I paid for them' Sanjay 2000 -> 'Sanjay owes me $2,000.00'; add 'They paid for me' 500 -> nets to 'Sanjay owes me $1,500.00', company settlement remains all $0 settled (unchanged), personal-txn delete works, Report dialog opens with download button. Google button on /login redirects into Emergent-managed OAuth flow (reached Google Sign-in page 'to continue to emergentagent.com'). Projects page shows delete-project-<id> for owner (MAISON 7). Regression: Dashboard net worth $452,076 AUD, MAISON 7 visible.

issues: fs-verdict node concatenates label with helper hint ('Feasible' + 'Needs profit > 0 and margin ≥ 15%'). Not a functional bug — matches spec — but exact-match assertions on the testid text will read both strings.

In-dialog view shows Company settlement + Transaction history only; personal debts appear only in the downloaded .txt (not rendered inside the dialog). Matches downloadable-report spec but users may expect on-screen personal section too.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user: pending_approval gate compares request.url.path exactly to '/api/auth/me' and '/api/auth/logout' — this is fine, but consider allow-listing /api/auth/refresh too so pending users can silently refresh their session cookie without hitting 403 on refresh calls.

server.py /api/projects listing: partners.email match is case-sensitive on stored value but stored lower-cased on create/update — safe as long as user.email is also lower-cased on insert (it is in google_session; ADMIN_EMAIL lower-case seed also OK). Good.

server.py loan_metrics amortizing branch: when r == 0 and elapsed >= term, monthly = outstanding/remaining with outstanding=0 → 0/1 = 0. Fine, but keep an eye on r==0 with elapsed<term uses outstanding/remaining (linear). Non-blocking.
Partners.jsx report dialog does not render personal debts on-screen; only .txt export includes them. Consider adding a section to match user expectation.

server.py CORSMiddleware: allow_origins uses single FRONTEND_URL env fallback to localhost — with same-origin relative /api this is not exercised in preview, but should be verified for multi-preview deployments.
seed_data_creation: During tests: transient test users via mongosh (auth_testing.md); TEST_ prefixed feasibility studies, TEST_SHARED_PROJECT, TEST_ISO_INV investments, TEST_PERSONAL_* ledger. All cleaned up (verified with mongosh deleteMany count=1 leftover feasibility purged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified. Auth playbook /app/auth_testing.md accurately simulates Google sessions via mongosh; use Bearer <session_token> for API tests, cookie injection for browser. Data isolation confirmed at API level — new google user starts pending and gets 403 pending_approval on /api/dashboard until admin POST /api/admin/users/{id}/status {status:'approved'}. Project sharing: add partner with matching email; shared field flag in GET /api/projects. Owner-only writes enforced on contributions/costs/loans/delete. Personal debts stored as ledger type='personal' with user_id scoping, computed via /api/ledger/personal (separate from /api/ledger/balances). Feasibility formula: total = land + construction*(1+contingency_pct/100) + bond + council + design + finance + legal + marketing + other; feasible = profit>0 AND margin>=15%.
